title: Counterspeech the ultimate shield! Multi-Conditioned Counterspeech Generation through Attributed Prefix Learning
measurement_description: The paper measures the generation of multi-attributed (strategy- and emotion-conditioned) counterspeech against online hate speech targeting specific marginalized groups, including religious groups (Muslims, Jews). It evaluates the generated counterspeech for lexical similarity, semantic relevance, strategy conformity, emotion conformity, target conformity, and toxicity reduction.
findings: The paper's proposed model (HiPPrO) successfully generates high-quality, non-toxic counterspeech that counters hate speech targeting religious groups like Muslims and Jews. By using multi-attribute conditioning (intent/strategy and emotion), the model effectively addresses Islamophobic and antisemitic hate speech with appropriate emotional resonance (e.g., joy, disgust) and strategy, outperforming baselines like GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 in producing nuanced, target-specific counter-narratives without relying on explicit instructional prompts.
